title: `voids/plenitude-void` cites Simons & Chabris (1999) for confident post-hoc scene descriptions by gorilla non-noticers, which the paper does not report, and credits Churchland (1981) with a thesis about "phenomenal content" that the paper never states; "outside memory" and a Rahnev paraphrase also need provenance fixes; it also absorbs the page's unchecked quotations (Bronfman, Ward, Knotts, Noë, Blackmore) and Noë's grand-illusion grouping (merged 2026-11-20)
